english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.caller.mess: Adjust what {deviceLabel} may receive through this parent trust link.
{remoteLabel} is connected as a parent/caregiver device.
{remoteLabel} is connected as a protected receiving device.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.caller.intr: Apply this update once, or save this parent/caregiver link so future approved updates can keep this protected profile in sync.
Save what this parent/caregiver can update later. Matching signed updates still have to pass the saved profile, scope, revision, and device checks.
Save the parent-side policy now. The protected device still chooses locally whether to trust and auto-apply on its own side.
Choose which parts of this protected profile this saved parent link can change.
Choose which parts of this protected profile this saved parent link can change. {scopes} must stay enabled for this approval.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.scope.descr: Only the main YouTube rules and lists.
Only the Kids profile rules and lists.
Only keyword rules from the selected Main or Kids surface.
Only channel rules from the selected Main or Kids surface.
Only blocked video IDs from the selected Main or Kids surface.
Keyword, channel, and blocked-video rules from the selected Main or Kids surface.
Only Main/Kids access policy for the protected profile.
Only the protected profile daily YouTube time limit.
The wider account snapshot, best for full migration.
The currently active FilterTube profile snapshot.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.default.cop: Choose the area FilterTube should use first when this parent sends an update through the saved link.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.default.opt: Used as the main update area.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.apply.merge: Keep what is already here and add the parent update.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.apply.repla: Replace this area with the parent-approved update.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.autoApply.b: Matching updates still need the saved parent link, profile target, allowed area, revision, and signature.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.reconnect.c: Choose whether this saved parent link can connect quickly next time or should ask again on this device.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.reconnect.f: The parent link is saved. Future live sessions reopen faster and still follow these saved rules.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.reconnect.a: Future live sessions stop for approval on this device before continuing.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.openSync.bo: When this protected profile opens, it can look for newer signed parent updates from the saved parent link. If no pickup path is set up, current rules stay active.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.target.head: Where parent updates land
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.target.copy: This parent link will always update {profileName} on this device, even if someone switches profiles later.
Choose whether future parent updates follow whichever profile is active or always land in this protected profile.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.target.curr: Future updates follow whichever profile is active on this device at receive time. Use carefully for shared devices.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.target.fixe: Best for protected profiles. Parent updates always land here, even if another profile is active later.
Choose how this protected profile handles future parent updates. Parent managed is the normal caregiver setup.
Let this trusted parent link send approved updates to this protected profile. Every update still validates device, profile, area, revision, and signature.
Require local approval or unlock before later updates can apply. Use this when this device should decide every time.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.locked.head: When this profile is locked
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.locked.copy: Choose whether signed parent updates can apply while the profile stays locked. This permission is saved only on this device.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.locked.requ: This profile must be locally unlocked before parent updates can apply.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.locked.allo: Matching signed updates from this saved parent link may apply without unlocking this profile each time.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.error.noAll: Pick at least one allowed area before saving this parent link.
english.dashboard.sync.managedPolicy.error.locke: {scopes} must stay enabled for this approval.
